verdict.rationale: Fellow is a SaaS product with a Developer API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack does not document one. The help article on the Developer API explicitly mentions no sandbox or test workspace, and all documented API calls run against the live workspace, with no dry-run or isolated test mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
